carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible across the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with lighter pixels on the upper edge and shadowed lower edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, near-vertical linear feature of high pixel intensity (~255 luminance) bisects the lateral patterning posterior to the head and gill region.
other_distinctive_markers: A region of unique, non-linear, maze-like or whorl-like patterning is visible in the upper-mid flank area, distinct from the standard grid pattern.
